verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's official docs say it can serve as the backend model for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode with no code required. Its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API (now also the Responses format) lets standard SDKs and compatible frameworks connect by changing configuration, backed by a maintained function-calling guide and a DeepSeek Harness developer preview for agent harness developers. Community users report running it through OpenRouter and the Cline plugin, though the Cline remark is about output quality rather than the integration itself. missing for 10: a first-party DeepSeek SDK, skills or plugins (integration relies on compatibility layers), detailed per-tool setup guides for named agent frameworks, and independent hands-on confirmation of the documented coding-agent setups.
